original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹本提乌流离失所营地家长联合帮助子女摆脱毒品与帮派
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹团结州本提乌流离失所者营地内，家长联合社区高层委员会、政府当局及联合国南苏丹特派团，帮助青少年摆脱毒品和帮派。该营地收容超过11万名流离失所者，廉价合成毒品与阿片类药物泛滥，成瘾青年为求保护加入帮派。联合国南苏丹特派团与社区及Vision Youth Group共同开展辅导与信心建设举措。

location.site: 本提乌流离失所者营地

key_facts.fact: 本提乌流离失所者营地收容超过11万名流离失所者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Bentiu camp, which provides a refuge for more than 110,000 displaced people

key_facts.fact: 营地内廉价合成毒品与阿片类药物泛滥，成瘾青年加入帮派
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the wave of easily available and cheap synthetic drugs and opioids is alluring, as addicted youth join gangs for protection and to help feed their habits

key_facts.fact: 家长联合社区高层委员会，并联系政府当局和联合国南苏丹特派团
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: we took it up with the community high committee in the camp... The committee reached out to government authorities and the United Nations Mission in South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹特派团、社区与Vision Youth Group设立针对该问题的举措
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: initiatives dedicated to tackling this challenge were established by UNMISS, the community, and the Vision Youth Group

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源报道（联合国南苏丹特派团），尚缺乏独立交叉验证
